arms.B-BASE: unmodified ArchB, byte-identical config to EXP-FP-0010 make_B (action_mode='active_inference', affect='none', default etas).
arms.B-RETENTION: ArchBRetention (additive subclass in prototypes/architecture-b/retention_guard.py): identical config; the generative model is swapped at construction for RetentionGuardModel, an HierarchicalGenerativeModel subclass overriding observe() to scale ONLY etaR (the per-context R-table rate) by 1/kappa on trials with reward <= goal_thresh, restoring the saved rate afterwards. w_r/b_r rates, precision, memory, selector, affect untouched. B's core files untouched (sha256 verified G0).

background: EXP-FP-0010-POMAZE-DIAG (2026-10-07) found arch-B's goal trials register TRANSIENTLY: across 88 goal probes (B-STD+DENSE+NEAR), mean|1.0-rhat| moves 1.2271 (first half) -> 0.9852 (second half) but only 36/88 = 0.41 are closer when re-evaluated at run end (mean|1.0-rhat_at_end| = 1.1828, i.e. the head ends up slightly NEGATIVE at the goal state/action). B finds the goal at 22x random (p_goal 0.133 vs 0.006) but cannot retain what it finds: a credit-RETENTION failure, distinct from the exploration failure. Follow-up synthetic replay (documented in the preregistration record) localized the washout: on the single pomaze context, the goal trial pushes R_ctx[a*] by dR = etaR*piR*rerr ~= +0.94 (etaR=0.10, piR~=9); every subsequent trial that re-uses action a* with reward -0.01 produces rerr ~= -0.01 - R[a*], a SELF-ERASING leaky integrator driving R[a*] back to ~0 within ~50 ticks. The global head (w_r/b_r) tracks the -0.01 background mean by design and never held goal credit. The episodic store is NOT the locus: it is unbounded (no overwrite) and reward prediction never queries it (retrieval feeds only next-obs correction and per-action error prediction for IG). Precision (piR ~= 9-20 on near-constant streams) amplifies both registration and erasure; it is a gain, not the locus.

baseline.retention_fraction: 0.41 (36/88 goal probes closer at run end, EXP-FP-0010 D7 STD+DENSE+NEAR; B-STD sub-slice 0.50, n=12)

conditions.episodes: 15 per (arm, seed) per env; one persistent agent object per (arm, seed) across episodes
conditions.paired: same 4 primary seeds for both arms on every env

controls.changing_rule: healthy rule-switch task; gate: B-RETENTION seed-mean return >= 0.7 * B-BASE seed-mean
controls.delayed_reward: sparse delayed-reward task (most trials r<=0, so the intervention is heavily exercised); gate: B-RETENTION seed-mean return >= 0.7 * B-BASE seed-mean
controls.rationale: the intervention slows R-table learning on ALL non-positive trials; it must not destroy healthy-task competence

frozen_gates.G0_additivity: 7 canonical files byte-identical before and after (sha256 pre/post in receipt); variants are new files only
frozen_gates.G1_fabrication_tripwire: CLEAN on all new/modified code, checked pre-run
frozen_gates.G2_determinism: recompute (B-RETENTION, pomaze, seed 96001): unrounded mean_return must match at 1e-9; else VOID
frozen_gates.G3_receipts: hash-chained ndjson receipts/EXP-FP-0012-RETENTION.ndjson (kinds: preregistration, env_config, seed_result, diagnosis, verdict, determinism_check; prev_hash + receipt_hash; chain verified at end)
frozen_gates.G5_controls: changing_rule AND delayed_reward gates must pass, else the intervention is REJECTED regardless of pomaze outcome

hypothesis: H-RETENTION: the asymmetric R-table rate is the surgical fix for the measured washout. Slowing ONLY the erasure leg (non-positive trials) lengthens the retention half-life of goal credit ~20x while leaving registration (positive trials) and background-mean tracking (w_r/b_r) intact. Predicts: (a) retention fraction on canonical pomaze >= 0.70 vs 0.41 baseline; (b) mean|1.0 - rhat_at_end| materially below the 1.18 baseline; (c) p_goal on pomaze at or above paired B-BASE (retention can only help once goals are found); (d) no control-task damage (G5).

intervention.effect: on trials with reward > goal_thresh: etaR unchanged (full registration). On trials with reward <= goal_thresh: etaR := etaR / kappa for the duration of observe(), then restored.
intervention.mechanistic_rationale: kappa=20 lengthens the R[a*] erasure half-life from ~2 trials to ~40 trials (synthetic-replay estimate), covering a full episode of subsequent -0.01 trials while keeping the R-table adaptive on the ~750-trial run timescale. w_r/b_r deliberately untouched: they never held goal credit (measured) and slowing them would degrade background-mean tracking on the control tasks.
intervention.scope: etaR only (the measured washout locus). eta0/etaD/eta_r, precision estimators, episodic store, selector, affect: untouched.

limitations: 4 seeds (task minimum) rather than 6; 15 eps/seed (matches the battery; longer horizons might reveal slow learning). Single preregistered kappa (no tuning sweep — a sweep would be a separate experiment). The intervention slows ALL non-positive-trial R updates, including legitimate negative-credit learning; the controls bound that cost. CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED — this experiment measures closed-loop returns and reward-head telemetry; no claims about conscious state. Donor provenance: n/a (no donor code; lab-native mechanisms only).
null_hypothesis: Washout persists: B-RETENTION retention fraction stays < 0.70 and mean|1.0-rhat_at_end| stays ~= 1.18 — the failure is elsewhere (e.g. the linear head cannot hold the goal signature under aliasing even with slower erasure, or the w_r component's piR-driven dynamics dominate). A null result is recorded in research/negative_results.md as a preserved negative.
preregistered_metric: PRIMARY: retention fraction = fraction of goal probes with |1.0 - rhat_at_end| < |1.0 - rhat_at_trial|, pooled over seeds, canonical pomaze only; gate >= 0.70 vs 0.41 baseline. SECONDARY: mean|1.0 - rhat_at_end| vs 1.1828 baseline; per-(arm,seed) mean_return and p_goal on pomaze (paired); control-task seed-mean returns vs 0.7x gates. Per-episode: return, goal, steps_to_goal, stuck_frac; per-goal-probe: obs_vec (excluded from receipts), action, ctx, rhat_at_trial, reward_at_trial, rhat_at_end. Decision on 4-seed aggregates; per-seed tables reported.
seed_freshness: 4 fresh primary seeds 96001..96004.
